details:
Heat Signal is a web based application that lets users explore temperature trends using NASA POWER data. Users can select/comparison locations, view monthly temperature data, see yearly trend lines and statistical context and download the data in CSV format. The site pulls data when requested and provides this information with explanations relating to the data source, time frame and analysis.

This project makes it easier to explore climate data by providing transparency around uncertainties. Using the location focussed interface allows users to easily link global climate signals to areas they are familiar with. Being able to compare and download data means users can explore further. This project aims to help students and the public engage with NASA Earth science data, and make informed and evidence based observations.

This site was built using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It uses NASA POWER for data. Creatively it provides a simple visual interface to explore data with clear trend analysis. We considered how much data was available, how clear it was, uncertainties in the data, ease of use and limitations of interpreting data from a grid. This means the results do not reflect what a local thermometer would show but instead what the data point in the grid shows over that time period.
